modes.name: Unreleased development
modes.entry_basis: Current project state: no actual released passenger train. Nonstructural mockups/research only within their specific safe scope.
modes.prohibition: No passenger/field operation from this Site.

modes.name: Out of service / protected work
modes.entry_basis: Recorded defect or maintenance; protected track/work area, independent vehicle restraint and energy-specific isolation accepted for task.
modes.prohibition: No dispatch; only separately authorized guarded work/test mode.

modes.name: Secured inspection / charging
modes.entry_basis: Actual configured consist restrained, people clear, protected route and approved charge/functional-check procedure.
modes.prohibition: No automatic traction permission from charging or static pressure.

modes.name: Secured boarding
modes.entry_basis: At accepted interface, stopped and physically held by accepted parking/holding arrangement; route and passenger area protected.
modes.prohibition: No departure with any door/gate/stair/lift unsecured, unclear boarding signal or unresolved fault.

modes.name: Authorized normal run
modes.entry_basis: Accepted route/mode/direction, every-vehicle brake release/reserve/continuity and boarding clear; designated driver and dispatch functions confirm.
modes.prohibition: Any credible stop request, readiness loss or route/communication conflict removes dispatch permission under accepted response.

modes.name: Stopped incident / emergency
modes.entry_basis: Accepted stop response invoked; protect route and people, assess whether remaining aboard or evacuation is safer. Verify and maintain accepted holding/restraint for controlled assisted unloading, with actual changing floor/suspension state; urgent fire/smoke escape follows its separate accepted emergency priority.
modes.prohibition: No reset-and-go, generic caging/towing or unapproved movement to a station.

modes.name: Specialist rescue / recovery
modes.entry_basis: Separate engineered plan, independent restraint, qualified people/equipment and protected route; actual isolated brakes and vehicle damage recorded.
modes.prohibition: No passenger-service permission and no improvised rerailing/lifting/pushing.

modes.name: Return-to-service hold
modes.entry_basis: Repairs/configuration/inspection and required regression complete, actual brakes restored, accountable signoffs and actual readiness rechecked.
modes.prohibition: Only specifically accepted configuration may re-enter inspection/boarding/run modes.

important: Functional development modes, not software state code or cab switch positions. Mode labels alone cannot secure a vehicle.
